 pl Paramlist;
BEGIN

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl);

 Add_Parameter(pl,'P_LAB_CODE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:s_testing_lab_code);
 CALL_FORM( lower('LTLREAG') ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,QUERY_ONLY ,pl);

 erase('GLOBAL.test_kit_id');
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl);
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 Handle_error;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 ctr number(4) := GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT('TESTLIST');
 rg_id recordgroup := FIND_GROUP('TESTLIST');
 gc_id1 groupcolumn := FIND_COLUMN('TESTLIST.TEST');
 gc_id2 groupcolumn := FIND_COLUMN('TESTLIST.GROUP');
 gc_id3 groupcolumn := FIND_COLUMN('TESTLIST.DESC');
 v_test varchar2(10);
 v_group varchar2(10);
 v_test_desc varchar2(50);
 antigen_flag varchar2(1) := 'N';
 temp_x varchar2(1);
BEGIN
 :disp_message := null;
 for cnt in 1 .. ctr 
 loop
 v_test := GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(gc_id1, cnt);
 v_group := GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(gc_id2, cnt); 
 v_test_desc := GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(gc_id3, cnt);
 BEGIN 
 SELECT distinct 'x' INTO temp_x 
 FROM master_codes 
 WHERE code_type = 'ANTGR'
 AND code = v_group
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 IF antigen_flag = 'N' THEN
 :ctrl_blk_wks.select := 'x';
 :ctrl_blk_wks.test_id := 'ANTIGEN';
 :ctrl_blk_wks.test_desc := 'Antigen Tests';
 antigen_flag := 'Y';
 next_record;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 IF test_printable(v_test) THEN
 :ctrl_blk_wks.select := 'x';
 :ctrl_blk_wks.test_id :=v_test;
 :ctrl_blk_wks.test_desc := v_test_desc;
 next_record;
 END IF;
 WHEN others THEN
 null;
 END;
 end loop;
 first_record;
 IF ctr = 1 THEN 
 execute_trigger('KEY-COMMIT');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: COMMIT_PROC
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE COMMIT_PROC IS
BEGIN
 IF :system.block_status = 'CHANGED' THEN
 :system.message_level := 10;
 commit;
 IF not FORM_SUCCESS THEN
 message('Error on Commit');
 :system.message_level := 0;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE 
 :GLOBAL.accept := null;
 :GLOBAL.err_cd := '9303'; 
 IF printable THEN
 call_form( lower('WARNING') ,no_hide);
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.accept := 'N';
 END IF;
 IF :GLOBAL.accept = 'Y' THEN
 CREATE_LIST; 
 go_block('ctrl_blk_wks');
 ELSE
 :system.message_level := 0;
 show_error('0000');
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 erase('GLOBAL.accept'); 
 END IF; 
 ELSE
 show_error('8013');
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_SPECIFIC_WS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure print_specific_ws 
is
 p_name varchar2(30);
 temp_parm_id VARCHAR2(30);
 temp_count number;
 ttype varchar2(5) := null;
 t_mode varchar2(15) := 'NORMAL';
begin
 IF :ctrl_blk_wks.test_id = 'ANTIGEN' THEN
 p_name := 'TSRANTWS';
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT test_type INTO ttype
 FROM valid_test_types 
 WHERE test_id = :ctrl_blk_wks.test_id
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN 
 return;
 END; 
 IF ttype is not null THEN
 p_name := 'LTRCNFWS';
 else
 p_name := 'LTRWKSHT';
 end if;
 END IF;
 temp_parm_id := substr(:ctrl_blk_1.tb_id,10,4)||'_'||
 replace(replace(:ctrl_blk_wks.test_id,'-',''),' ','');
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from rpt_parm
 where appl_id = 'DON'
 and user_name = :banner.user_id 
 and report_name = p_name
 and parm_id = temp_parm_id;
 if temp_count = 0 then
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm
 (appl_id, user_name, report_name, parm_id,
 parm_date, submit_date, report_status)
 values
 ('DON', :banner.user_id, p_name,
 temp_parm_id, sysdate, sysdate, 'E');
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 else
 begin
 update rpt_parm 
 set submit_date = SYSDATE, 
 report_status = 'E'
 where appl_id = 'DON'
 and user_name = :banner.user_id 
 and report_name = p_name
 and parm_id = temp_parm_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 begin
 delete from rpt_parm_select
 where appl_id = 'DON' 
 and user_name = :banner.user_id 
 and report_name = p_name
 and parm_id = temp_parm_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 end if;
 post;
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id, user_name, report_name, parm_id,
 parm_no, parm_select, parm_code)
 values
 ('DON', :banner.user_id, p_name,
 temp_parm_id, 1, :GLOBAL.chapter_id, 'CHP');
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id, user_name, report_name, parm_id,
 parm_no, parm_select, parm_code)
 values
 ('DON', :banner.user_id, p_name,
 temp_parm_id, 2, :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id, 'TBAT');
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 IF p_name != 'TSRANTWS' THEN
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id, user_name, report_name, parm_id,
 parm_no, parm_select, parm_code)
 values
 ('DON', :banner.user_id, p_name,
 temp_parm_id, 3, :ctrl_blk_wks.test_id, 'TSTID');
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 IF p_name = 'TERMCONF' THEN
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id, user_name, report_name, parm_id,
 parm_no, parm_select, parm_code)
 values
 ('DON', :banner.user_id, p_name,
 temp_parm_id, 4, ttype, 'TTYPE');
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 message('Error in Submitting Worksheet');
 handle_error;
 end;
 commit;
 BEGIN
 select forms_type into t_mode 
 from rpt_report_names
 where appl_id = 'DON'
 and report_name = p_name;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 null;
 END;
 host ('nohup repgen.sh -a'||'SBC '||
 '-t'||'PC '||
 '-r'||p_name||' '||
 '-p'||temp_parm_id||' '||
 '-u'||:banner.user_id||' '||
 '-q'||:GLOBAL.user_printer_id||' '||
 '-f'|| ' ' || t_mode|| ' ' || 
 '-h'||' -l '||
 '-c'||:GLOBAL.chapter_id||' > /dev/null &');
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINTABLE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
Function Printable return boolean is
 cur_item varchar2(40) := :system.cursor_item;
 cur_rec number(4) := :system.cursor_record;
 temp_count number(4);
 temp_x varchar2(1);
BEGIN
 go_block('test_batch_det');
 first_record;
 loop
 IF test_printable(:test_batch_det.test_id) THEN
 go_item(cur_item);
 go_record(cur_rec);
 RETURN TRUE ;
 END IF;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 next_record;
 end loop;
 go_item(cur_item);
 go_record(cur_rec);
 RETURN FALSE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: TEST_PRINTABLE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION TEST_PRINTABLE(p_test_id varchar2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 temp_x varchar2(1);
 temp_count number(3);
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT distinct 'x' INTO temp_x 
 FROM valid_test_bands
 WHERE test_id = p_test_id 
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 WHEN others THEN 
 handle_error;
 END;
 SELECT count(*) INTO temp_count
 FROM valid_test_types
 WHERE test_id = p_test_id
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 IF temp_count = 1 THEN
 RETURN TRUE;
 END IF;
 RETURN FALSE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CREATE_LIST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE create_list IS
 rg_id RECORDGROUP;
 gc_id GROUPCOLUMN;
 ctr number(3) := 0; 
BEGIN
 go_block('test_batch_det');
 first_record;
 rg_id := FIND_GROUP('TESTLIST');
 IF not ID_NULL(rg_id) THEN
 DELETE_GROUP(rg_id);
 END IF;
 rg_id := CREATE_GROUP('TESTLIST');
 gc_id := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(rg_id,'TEST',CHAR_COLUMN,10);
 gc_id := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(rg_id,'GROUP',CHAR_COLUMN,5);
 gc_id := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(rg_id,'DESC',CHAR_COLUMN,50);
 loop
 ctr := ctr +1 ;
 ADD_GROUP_ROW(rg_id, END_OF_GROUP);
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('TESTLIST.TEST',ctr, :test_batch_det.test_id);
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('TESTLIST.GROUP',ctr, :test_batch_det.test_group);
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('TESTLIST.DESC',ctr, :test_batch_det.s_test_desc);
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 next_record;
 end loop; 
END;
